name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a stint as a Garda Síochána officer in Dublin, he found the rigid structure unfulfilling. A chance encounter at a local rally event sparked his interest in the high-stakes world of motorsport, recognizing the need for a more dynamic and adaptable security presence. He transitioned his skills in risk assessment and crowd control to the track. 

His approach to security is proactive and preventative, focusing on building strong relationships with the team and anticipating potential threats. Declan is known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo, constantly seeking innovative solutions to safeguard the team and its assets. His loyalty to Oregon Team is absolute, valuing trust and discretion above all else, making him a valuable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight wave.
physical.description: A sturdy build with a focused gaze that misses nothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Has a habit of polishing his sunglasses, even indoors.
Prefers to patrol the paddock on foot, believing it offers a better sense of the atmosphere.
